source: Allard & Atalla 2e Table 11.2, PDF page 260 (printed p. 254)
about: Table 11.2, "The parameters used to predict the effective density of the material in Figure 11.2": the soft fibrous material whose measured effective density, by Panneton (2007) with the method of Utsono et al. (1989), the limp-frame model of Sect. 11.3.4 is checked against. Columns as printed: thickness h (mm), phi, sigma (N s/m4), alpha_inf, Lambda (um), Lambda' (um) and rho_1 (kg/m3), all seven filled. No elastic constants: the point of the example is that the frame is too limp to need them.
